statement: Lambda's public pricing page does not list H200 or GB200 rental rates, and 1-year-plus terms are quoted only as custom pricing.
why: Newest-generation parts missing from self-serve price lists is consistent with those SKUs being allocated to committed contracts rather than open rental inventory.

impact.mechanism: Absence of published on-demand rates for newer accelerators suggests that capacity is spoken for under negotiated deals, limiting openly available rentable supply.

evidence.excerpt: Note: H200 and GB200 models were not listed with pricing on this page at time of fetch.

confidence.basis: Secondary single-vendor page; the absence of a listing is suggestive of allocation but has other benign explanations.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> unknown); sources: Lambda (lambda.ai), NVIDIA Blog
